name: SchoolAI
tagline: AI platform for teachers — lessons, tutoring, and student insights.
description: SchoolAI is a K-12 education platform that gives teachers AI assistants for prep and admin work plus 'Spaces' — personalized AI tutors, games, and lessons that adapt to each student. A 'Mission Control' dashboard lets teachers monitor student progress in real time, with safety guardrails and teacher control built in. It includes 'PowerUps' focused AI apps and a browser extension. Free for teachers to start, with paid plans for schools and districts.
insight: Raised a $25M Series A led by Insight Partners in 2025; used in 1M+ classrooms across all 50 US states and 80+ countries.

modelSupport.notes: Teacher-controlled AI tutors ('Spaces') built on frontier LLMs.

edge: Purpose-built for K-12 with teacher controls, student-safety guardrails and a live progress dashboard, unlike general-purpose classroom chatbots.
pros: AI lesson prep and admin help
